description: Open, content-addressed spend-authority references over the AlgoVoi substrate (RFC 8785 JCS + SHA-256). mandate_ref = "sha256:" + SHA-256(JCS({cap, payer, period, revocation_state})). This is exactly the mandate_ref that spend_guardrail_lite binds: mandate_1 / mandate_2 here equal mandate_1 / mandate_2 in the spend_guardrail_lite_v1 set, so the decision chain composes (mandate_ref -> the spend authority spend_guardrail binds). cap is a string. Each of the four fields is byte-load-bearing; a missing or empty field is rejected, not hashed. Lite tier: no signature; the commercial Payment Mandate adds Falcon-1024 PQC signing and per-period authorize-charge enforcement.
note_chain: mandate_1 (sha256:a4f8cb5e...) and mandate_2 (sha256:fefcf604...) are the mandate_1 / mandate_2 references in spend_guardrail_lite_v1; this set is the upstream origin of that mandate_ref.

negatives.note: same cap/period/state, different payer; mandate_ref diverges
the spending cap is byte-load-bearing; 1000 -> 2000 diverges the ref
the cap period is byte-load-bearing; monthly -> weekly diverges the ref
revocation_state is byte-load-bearing; active -> revoked diverges the ref (== pm-003)

negatives.reason: payer must be a non-empty string; an empty field is rejected, not hashed
cap must be a non-empty string; an empty field is rejected, not hashed

invariants.assert: changing any of {payer, cap, period, revocation_state} changes mandate_ref (pm-001, payer-swap, cap-tamper, period-tamper, revocation-tamper all distinct)
a mandate with any empty field is rejected
